purpose: The only queries this repo may open a page for. A query with no record here has no evidence anyone searches for it. Contrast with data/authority_scale/fanout_100k/, which holds 100,000 cartesian strings and is planning intelligence, never a publishing queue.

sources: Portfolio Search Packet v2, Semrush US, pulled 2026-08-24 (T2b)
Google autocomplete (suggestqueries.google.com, client=chrome, hl=en, gl=us), probed 2026-08-27
unmeasured_fields: autocomplete suggestions carry NO volume figure. A query present in autocomplete is evidence that the string is searched, not evidence of how often. No volume is inferred, estimated or invented for these records.

owner_seed_policy: An owner may add a record with source_type owner_approved_seed and volume null. It must carry approved_by and approved_at.

records.rejection_reason: Semrush mapped this query to porchandparty901.com on domain adjacency, not on what the business does. Porch & Party is a porch-decorating and celebration-styling company: it styles and installs decor. It owns no tents, no tables, no chairs, no linens and no venue, and it does not rent equipment. Ranking for this query would mean either becoming a rental company or landing the searcher on a page that cannot serve them. The local slate is also held by Mahaffey, operating in Memphis since 1924, plus national rental marketplaces. A page built for this query would be a page built to fail twice.

disposition_policy: A record with disposition REJECTED_WRONG_BUSINESS is evidence of what NOT to build. It stays in the file so the same wrong mapping cannot be re-imported and re-proposed, and validate:demand-backed-pages must not report it as an uncovered gap.

geo_expansion_finding.method: Google autocomplete probe, client=chrome, hl=en, gl=us
geo_expansion_finding.finding: Suburb-level geo queries for these services return ZERO autocomplete suggestions. Probed and empty: "porch decorating germantown", "event decorator collierville", "porch decorating cordova tn", "balloon garland memphis", "midtown memphis party". Only city-level strings returned suggestions ("party decorators memphis tn", "christmas decor memphis tn").
geo_expansion_finding.implication: Building a page per suburb per service on this evidence would be the fan-out mistake in a smaller shape - manufacturing URLs against demand that was never measured. areas/ already carries 16 suburb pages for the two services with any signal. Cordova and Midtown were the only named gaps and both probed empty, so neither was built.
